title: SimMOF: AI agent for Automated MOF Simulations
description: SimMOF is a large language model based multi-agent framework that automates end-to-end metal-organic framework (MOF) simulation workflows from natural language queries. It integrates Zeo++, RASPA, LAMMPS, VASP and Packmol, and handles workflow planning, input generation, job execution, error recovery and result analysis.
